Subject: Final invoice and VAT split for renewal RDW-4127

Hi Kimberly,

We're preparing our year-end ledger and need the final billing packet for our renewal (RDW-4127). Two asks: 1) can you split the final amount into a subscription invoice + an overage/true-up invoice (our AP team needs separate POs for recurring vs usage), and 2) confirm what VAT evidence you need from us for EU reverse-charge / VAT residency so we can get it to you in time.

Target payment date is Nov 30 (we're doing a single wire for both invoices once accepted). Can you confirm timelines for generating the invoices and any PO conversion form we should fill?

Thanks,

MedSprint Ltd

Hi Oliver —

Thanks — we can do the split you described. Quick outline and next steps:

- What we'll deliver: two PDF invoices (SUBSCRIPTION and TRUE-UP/OVERRUN).
- Timing: initial drafts by Wed 15 Nov, final signed PDFs by Mon 20 Nov if we have your PO numbers and VAT residency docs by Fri 17 Nov.
- PO conversion: we have a one-page PO conversion form we ask customers to sign when they need two invoice numbers (attached).
- VAT evidence: if you are applying reverse charge, we need a VAT registration certificate or EU VAT ID + the company legal name and address. We've attached a small template to tell you what fields to include.
- Wire instructions: we will include wire details on each invoice and a consolidated payment reference you can use when wiring both amounts.

Can you: 1) confirm the two PO numbers (or whether you want us to put separate invoice references and you will allocate), and 2) confirm who on your side will sign the PO conversion form?

I'll loop in Karthik for the invoice generation and Prioyom to coordinate the final acceptance and ledger tags.

Cheers,
